purpose: Teach: あゆみ/つきあっ/すさまじい/このほど/とかく/ぬけ/かれこれ/めちゃめちゃ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵のあゆみ、見せてあげる
lines.en: Sho, I want to show you how my drawing practice has been going.
lines.style: Warm opening, gentle pitch lift on his name. Soft and inviting—eager to share something personal without pressure. Even pace, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、おじいちゃんと長くつきあってきたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've been spending a long time with Grandpa.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest delivery. Small voice but grounded—he's sharing something he values. No rushing. Slight pause before the final thought, like he's making sure she understands what it means.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、昨日の雨はすさまじい雷だったわね
lines.en: Sho, wasn't yesterday's thunderstorm something else?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone—drawing him into a shared memory. Speaking a little slower, as if watching the storm again in her mind. Warm and observant, noticing what he might have noticed too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、このほど絵のコンクールで賞をもらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got a prize in an art contest recently.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice—not boastful, but solid. Small chest lifted slightly. He's telling her something that matters. Even pace, clear on the important word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはとかくお話が長いわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad does love to tell a long story, doesn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone—a shared private understanding between them. Slight smile in the voice. Warm without mockery. Unhurried pacing, like settling into comfortable territory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、靴ひもがぬけちゃった
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, small voice. A practical statement delivered with a hint of resigned humor—life's small inconveniences. Quick, untroubled. The briefness is the joke.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんもぼくも、かれこれ五年のお付き合いね
lines.en: Sho, we've been friends for about five years now, haven't we?
lines.style: Tender, reflective—she's acknowledging something precious. Slower pace on the time span. Warmth held steady underneath. A quiet recognition of something that's grown between them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、運動会でめちゃめちゃ走ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ran so hard at the sports day.
lines.style: Bright, alive energy. Quick pace on the accomplishment. Small voice carrying genuine excitement—he's reliving the feeling of moving fast. Open on the verb, proud without self-consciousness.
